text:
Ah, my heart, which no one wanted

to take between my desolate hands.

You came to look at its flames

and watched it burn clear and submissive.


(The deep foot upon the black floor

bled lights through all the days.

Before the geographic feet, silent,

your invisible doors, Paradise.)


You who threw another log onto the embers,

gather the ashes and the small

heart that moves you; join and leave it.


Someday you will sigh, some

night of solitude you will hear my complaint,

yours to the heart like no other.

translation.title: Ah, My Heart, Which No One Wanted...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the burned heart, Paradise doors, and future solitary complaint.
